coupon_short_description: Get 10,000 Free Diamonds in Restaurant Tycoon 3
coupon_description: <p>Restaurant Tycoon 3 is the third game in the 'Restaurant Tycoon' series of games created by Ultraw Games. Players build and grow their own restaurant by designing, upgrading, hiring staff, expanding the menu with global cuisines, and leveling up milestones.</p>
